entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: internal invariant violated: histogram call-subquery input has %s sample kind
entries.rationale: lowerSubqueryOverCallSubquery supplies kind from the successfully lowered wideInner plan and enters this dispatch only on its conservative histogram-bearing path. Ordinary lowering publishes validated float, histogram, or mixed schemas; this guard rejects only an opaque or invalid internal plan that the conservative predicate deliberately refuses to misroute as float.
